safe: accepted exact pull probability and fixed transforms
release age computed at target date
contextualButPriceLinked: peer-card price medians computed inside each training fold with target and all held-out groups removed
grading population or grading intensity if later date-bound; behavior responds to price
listing counts/velocity and liquidity if later date-bound
targetLeakage: target card current price as a feature
demand pressure or absorption calculated with target price
residual/gap from any model fit on held-out outcome
exclude: current chase rank based on price
any Collector refit or feature selection using Fair Value outcomes
rule: Performance never overrides leakage classification. Peer context is isolated to Model D and recomputed within training folds.
